items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Zutty Singleton) does not speak in the provided context. The interviewer mentions Jack Bland in a narrative about Charlie and the Mound City Blue Boys, but there is no statement from Zutty Singleton indicating a personal relationship with Jack Bland.

ctx.x: No, no, the Arcadian was like Roselord, and we were the first black band to play. They got Charlie to play at this hall on Pine Street. That's where it was -- in those days it was segregation, it wasn't integrated. It was all white at this dance hall, and that's where Jack Bland and --
